headline: Kamat Hotels releases investor presentation to the exchange
hook: Routine investor update from Kamat Hotels
summary: Kamat Hotels (I) Limited has officially submitted its investor presentation to the stock exchanges. The filing provides structural details regarding the company's business operations and strategic outlook. headline: Kamat Hotels discloses board meeting outcome
